text: Wadi Yutum is classified as high risk because forecast 3-hour rainfall exceeds the catchment's historical 99.5 percentile and antecedent soil moisture. The plume ensemble indicates a 75% probability of reaching Reef Zone R-08 within 3–24 hours.
